* preferred way to change many columns like when we subtract every column by their median


```{r}
library(tibble)
```
```{r}
df <- data.frame(matrix(runif(5 * 10), ncol = 5))
med <- vapply(df, median, numeric(1))
df[] <- Map(\(x,m) x - m, df, med)
```


```{r}
m <- matrix(1:20, nrow = 5)
m
length(m)
is.null(dim(m))
is.null(attr(1:20, "dim"))
is.null(attr(m, "dim"))
```


```{r}
f <- factor(c("a", "b", "c"), levels = c("b", "c", "a"))
f <- f |> relevel(ref = "c")
f
```

* data.matrix converts strings into factors and returns the internal value

```{r}
df <- data.frame(
x = 1:3,
  y = c("21", "41", "11")
)
df |> data.matrix()

```

* getting diagonal of a matrix


```{r}
df <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = 11:15) |> as.matrix()
df[row(df) == col(df)]
diag(df)

no_diags <- min(nrow(df), ncol(df))
df[
matrix(
  rep(
    seq_len(no_diags), each = 2
  ), ncol = 2, byrow = T
)
]

```

* lookup logic using match

```{r}
grade_tab <- data.frame(
  grade = 1:3,
  desc = c("Poor", "Good", "Excellent"),
  fail = c("T", "F", "F")
)
grades <- c(1,2,1,1,3,1)

results <- grade_tab[match(grades, grade_tab$grade), ]
results[sample(nrow(results)),]
results[sample(nrow(results), 7, replace = T),]

```


```{r}
df <- data.frame(x = c(1,2,3,11,1, 12), y = letters[1:6] )
df[df$x < 9,]
Filter(\(x) x < 9, df$x)
df$x |> sort(decreasing = T)
```
* Get count of non-primitive functions with 0 arguments in the base package


```{r}
funs <- mget(ls("package:base", all = T), inherits = T) |>
  Filter(f = is.function )

n_args <- funs |>
  Filter(f = \(x) !is.primitive(x)) |>
  lapply(formals) |>
  vapply(length, FUN.VALUE = numeric(1))

(n_args == 0) |> sum()
```

```{r}
func <- function(x) x 

e <- rlang::env()
rlang::env_bind(e, f = func)
names(e)
e
rlang::fn_env(func) |> identical(environment(func))

```


```{r}
ffac <- function() {
  function() {
    print(parent.frame())
    print(rlang::caller_env() |> identical(parent.frame()))
  }
}

ffac()()

```
